_readme: Every key is optional (a missing key = the default described in README 'Configuration'). orch.ps1 setup -WriteLocal writes skills/dev-kit/kit.local.json from this file (minus localFiles and the _-prefixed kit sections) and each localFiles entry to its path; all of them are git-ignored. Fill the <...> values. Paths: forward slashes work on every OS.
trackerLists: <tracker container whose promoted tasks deploy intest checks: list id / owner/repo / project key>

tracker._readme: type: none (default) | clickup | github | gitlab | jira. statuses maps the logical statuses to your board's names (a list = the first is set, all match). Examples for each backend: _examples.
tracker.list: <default list id / Jira project key for new tasks>
tracker.owner: <optional: assignee of new tasks; empty = your OS full name matched to a tracker member>
tracker.branchTag: <tag before the task id in branches and MR titles, e.g. CU- / GH- / PROJ- ; default from type>

reports._readme: type: gdocs (Google Docs + Drive via gws; default when gws is installed) | markdown (files in the run folder, carried by the tracker comment)

driveParent: <Google Drive folder or shared-drive id for testing docs and reports (reports.type gdocs)>

qa._readme: outOfScope: channels agent QA never tests (their steps are OUT_OF_SCOPE: reported, never counted). targets: target groups for /testy select runs (target: '<group>'): per task the first rule whose lists / repos / nameRegex / pathRegex match gives its env (localEnv: a local env, live = in its running release).
outOfScope: <a channel agent QA never tests, e.g. a chat app, email delivery, an error tracker>

deploy._readme: trigger: owner (default: nobody asks or proposes a deploy; a person says deploy <env> and the coordinator deploys at once) or ask (one batched ask per env, at most one per minIntervalHours: a number, or per target with a default). planTimeoutSec bounds orch.ps1 deploy plan.

net._readme: timeoutSec per git-host / tracker CLI call; transient errors retry, lost tracker writes wait in .state/outbox.jsonl (supervise replays them)

tests._readme: Per stack (dev.ps1 stack names): the test names -Touched looks for, from a changed source file's base name ({name}). Defaults: maven/gradle {name}Test, {name}Tests, {name}IT; dotnet {name}Tests, {name}Test; python test_{name}, {name}_test; go {name}_test; web {name}.spec, {name}.test.

localEnv._readme: Local envs (local-env skill): the dev flow tests every change here before merge. Any shape: a service is a start command in a folder. Secrets: <kit>/.state/localenv/<env>.env (dotenv), never here.

db.clone: <script: a DB server on {+5432} with a copy of the test data>

memory._readme: keepDefault: false = Claude Code auto memory lives in <kit>/memory/ (git-ignored); true = keep the user's own setting.

kitAudit._readme: everyDays: the SessionStart nudge asks for a kitty audit when the last audit is older (default 7; 0 = off).

build._readme: mavenOffline: Maven runs with -o when ~/.m2/repository exists (default true).

gate._readme: Memory gate. keepFreeGB (default 15% of RAM, min 6) = RAM every build leaves free; startHeapGB = first heap for a project with no history; heapMinGB = the floor.

budget._readme: README Configuration: the budget rule; estimate per planned agent / item (2026-10-16 runs)

claude-1m.source: Claude Code model-config docs: 1M models compact at ~967k

codex.source: community-derived: 0.9 x ~/.codex/models_cache.json window x effective %; auto_compact_token_limit wins

repos.name: web
repos.linkFrom: <a checkout whose node_modules can be linked (optional)>

deploys.target: <env deployed by hand onto a host>
<env deployed by hand, no way to check>

linkFromByTarget.<other target branch>: <a checkout of that branch with its own install>

linkPaths: <git-ignored file or folder every worktree needs, e.g. local credentials or local.properties>

bugfixMandate: <the owner's own words asking the coordinator to fix QA-raised bugs, verbatim>

skills/qa-kit/targets.local.json._readme: One entry per TEST environment (never production), the local env included. Passwords live ONLY here. users: <key for qa.ps1 api -As / browser.mjs as> -> [login, password].

skills/android-swarm/swarm.config.json._readme: Lanes = AVD names (swarm.ps1 avd create; iOS: a udid), each with its own test login ('user': targets.local.json) and 'notes'. avd {abi, api, device, tag}: lane image. app.kind: react-native | native | kmp | flutter | maui | capacitor | ios. localManifests: the app's cleartext manifests (debug variants) merged into the release build by build -Local; localReverse: ports acquire -Apk local reverses to this machine (local API).

_manifest._readme: The kit's registry (never copied into kit.local.json): the crew, skills, workflows, Router rows, Events rows and caps. Names live only here: kittool.py lint checks every file against it (MANIFEST, SCHEMA, OLD-NAME, AGENT-TYPE), kittool.py new / rename / remove edit it, port writes each agent's Character block and README's Crew table from it. renamed = the migration note (old -> new) orch.ps1 setup -Migrate applies to local state.

devy.job: builder: makes or changes anything in product repos through the dev flow
devy.cant: deploy, merge into deploy branches, edit the kit

character.bias: the smallest change that passes every goal

revy.job: reviewer: reviews anything and suggests concrete changes

character.bias: assumes a bug until the evidence proves otherwise
character.never: reports a problem without its fix, or edits the artefact itself

checky.job: tester: tests or verifies anything, always with evidence
checky.cant: edit code, leave its target, load shared envs

character.bias: a PASS is unproven until its evidence exists
character.never: trusts a PASS without proof or hides a defect in a note

kitty.job: kit caretaker: the kit and the machine setup
kitty.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, PowerShell, Agent

character.bias: one file, one fact, the smaller diff
character.never: adds a file, a key or a rule another one already covers

buildy.covers: any multi-item build: features, fixes, refactors, migrations, bug waves, resume, duels

testy.covers: any test run: tracker selection, smoke after a deploy, regression sweep, retest, on local or a test env

tidy.covers: kit upkeep: learning signals -> lessons + rule updates, cleanup, the weekly audit kick-off

_paths._readme: The ONE map of the kit's local state (never copied into kit.local.json). Scripts never build these paths by hand: PowerShell Get-KitPath (lib.ps1), Python kit_path (devtools.py / kittool.py), Node kitPath (spec.mjs / browser.mjs) and each workflow's rp() helper resolve names from here (kit-lint RUNTIME-RAW / RUNTIME-MAP enforce it). 'runtime' entries live under <runtime> = $CLAUDE_RUNTIME, else <kit>/.runtime: disposable (work/ = in-flight runs, cache/ = rebuilt on demand, logs/ = append-only). 'durable' entries live under <kit>/.state/ (git-ignored): knowledge and task state that must survive a runtime wipe. Folders end in '/'. orch.ps1 setup -Migrate moves the old layout (.claude-runtime, *.local.* state at the kit root) here.
